test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 14 March 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The income of Anil is ₹45,000. He saves 16% of his income. If his income decreases by 5% and the expenditure increases by 2%, then his saving decrease by:
solution:
Given:

The income of Anil is ₹45,000. He saves 16% of his income. 

Later his income decreases by 5% and the expenditure increases by 2%,

Concept used:

Incremented/Reduced value = Initial value (1 ± change%)

Calculation:

His saving = 16% of 45,000

⇒ Rs. 7200

His expenditure = 45,000 - 7200
